_why: 武虾 world constraint (design/90_decisions.md): every character in this
game is a shrimp — the ones here and every one added later. This file is
what makes that rule enforceable. tests/test_shrimp_roster.py holds it and
assets/characters/*.png to a strict one-to-one: an unregistered portrait
goes red, and so does a roster row with no portrait.
The gate CANNOT look at a PNG and tell whether it depicts a shrimp. It is
not trying to. What it enforces is that adding a character forces you to
write down which shrimp it is — turning a rule that lives in someone's
memory into a door that stops you. A rule with no guard drifts; this
pipeline is agent-driven and the third round from now will not remember.
species is prose, deliberately: it is read by a human authoring art, not
parsed. It must be non-empty, which is the whole machine-checkable part.
DEADPAN: only the portrait and the title are shrimp. Event/gongfa/skill
prose stays straight wuxia. See the decision record before changing tone.
